messages.text: BL-1741 🎵 in progress — extension/test/emitLifecycleSnapshotCli.test.js breaks the unit suite's 7 s per-file budget in every worktree (QA, BL-1717's parcel: 16.1 s in-suite, 9.6 s alone) yet takes 35 ms on main - its 'the compiled CLI runs against the real repo' test runs emit-lifecycle-snapshot against the checkout it sits in, which walks the full backlog history unless that checkout already holds a same-day snapshot, and only main does (QA and coder@2 have none, coder's dates from 2026-09-06); the test then deletes or restores what it wrote, so a worktree walks again on every run; the test runs the CLI against a fixture git checkout and never reads or writes a live one
